excluded.reason: fewer than 2 products in stored response

definitions.unit_of_count: product = one of the two products of one stored comparison response; pair = one stored response (both products). Repeated captures of the same query are counted as separate observations (w412 rows 3-5, 12-13, 15-25 repeat pairs).
definitions.product_source: the RAW top-level products[] alias (result_gate._raw_products), image_url from overview.products[i] then products[i] (result_gate._image_present order), specs from specs.products[i].specs then products[i].specs (result_gate._specs_of)
definitions.identity: present = NOT result_gate.product_is_placeholder (normalised brand+name dedup and name alone not in {'', unknown, unknown product, n/a, product, this product})
definitions.image_url: present = string starting https:// with a dotted host, path not .svg/.svgz, no placeholder token (placeholder, no-image, noimage, no_image, default-image). Extension recorded in image_ext_counts (tif counted as raster).
definitions.price_not_estimated: present = price.amount a real number > 0 AND price.unavailable is not True AND price.estimated is not True AND price.source_method != 'estimated' (result_gate.price_is_present_literal plus amount > 0). source_method and timestamp presence recorded per product.
definitions.price_timestamp: price dict carries any of retrieved_at, fetched_at, timestamp, as_of, scraped_at, updated_at, observed_at, captured_at, price_ts, last_seen, checked_at. (Response-level metadata.timestamp is recorded per pair separately.)
definitions.price_url_kind: search_page = url contains google.com/search, /search, ?q=, &q=, ?s=, ?kw= or search?; pdp_or_other = any other non-empty url; none = no url
definitions.size: present = price.size non-NA, or a specs key in {volume,size,net_volume,net_content,net_weight,count,capacity,storage,pack_size,quantity} non-NA, or a size token (number + ml/l/oz/g/kg/gb/tb/tablets/capsules/softgels/count/ct/pcs/sachets) in name/full_name/variant
definitions.concentration: fragrance pairs only: specs.concentration or price.concentration non-NA, or a concentration phrase (extrait, parfum intense, eau de parfum/EDP, eau de toilette/EDT, eau de cologne/EDC, eau fraiche, parfum) in name/full_name/variant
definitions.specs: specs_count = result_gate.real_spec_rows_one_side (string keys not starting with _, value not in NA {'', n/a, na, none, unknown, -}); present = count >= 1
definitions.rating_real: present = rating a real number in (0,5], rating_derived is not True (result_gate.rating_is_real), rating_source is a dict with a non-empty name and extract_method not in {gpt_review_aggregate, derive_rating_from_scores, derived, estimated}
definitions.fragrance_by_stored_category: pair whose stored response category (category or category_used) is 'fragrances', or both products' stored category is 'fragrances'
definitions.fragrance_by_content: INFERRED classification over MEASURED fields: stored-fragrance pairs plus pairs where either product has a concentration phrase or perfume word in brand/name/full_name/variant, or a FRAGRANCE_BRAND_KEYWORDS brand (app/services/price_service.py) together with an ml/oz size token, or >= 2 populated fragrance spec keys (scent_family, notes_top/heart/base, longevity, sillage, concentration). Catches w412 rows 20-25 (Tom Ford perfumes stored as category 'other').
definitions.pair_rate: pair_both_present / pair_n where a pair counts only when BOTH products have the field present
definitions.tags: every count and rate in this file is measured from the fixture bytes at the code root; only the fragrance_by_content membership rule is an inferred classification

second_pass.method: scripts/baseline_b.py: no app.* import; walks tests/fixtures and detects full-response shapes structurally; own normaliser, own concentration regex, FRAGRANCE_BRAND_KEYWORDS read from price_service.py source via ast; compared record by record (12 fields x every product) and tally by tally by scripts/baseline_merge.py
second_pass.pass_a_script: scripts/baseline_a.py (imports app.services.result_gate predicates and price_service.extract_concentration behind a dotenv stub and a socket deny guard; net calls attempted: 0)
